subject: english
question:
The sentence given below has spelling errors. Select the sentence without spelling errors.

We can also contribute to presarvation of water bodies by not dumping our garbage in them.

options.text: We can also contribute to presarvation of water bodies by not dumpeing our garbage in them.
We can also contribute to preservation of water bodies by not dumping our garbage in them.
We can also contribut to presarvation of water bodies by not dumping our garbage in them.
We can also contribute to presarvation of water bodies by not dumping our garbag in them.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"presarvation"** is incorrect. The correct spelling is **"preservation"**, which means the act of maintaining something in its original or existing state. (संरक्षण)

 
 
• **Example:** The preservation of historical monuments is crucial for cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• The word **"dumping"** means disposing of something carelessly or irresponsibly. (फेंकना)
 
 
• **Example:** Dumping waste into rivers can cause severe environmental damage.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***We can also contribute to preservation of water bodies by not dumping our garbage in them***. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "We can also contribute to presarvation of water bodies by not dumpeing our garbage in them."

 
 
• **Presarvation** (संरक्षण): Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Dumpeing** (फेंकना): Incorrect spelling of "dumping".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "We can also contribut to presarvation of water bodies by not dumping our garbage in them."
 
 
• **Contribut** (योगदान): Incorrect spelling of "contribute".
 
• **Presarvation** (संरक्षण): Incorrect spelling.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "We can also contribute to presarvation of water bodies by not dumping our garbag in them."
 
 
• **Presarvation** (संरक्षण): Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Garbag** (कचरा): Incorrect spelling of "garbage".
